audit_method: Independent CPU reconstruction from frozen source, official shim prompt/tokenizer, raw judgments and saved candidate scores; no new inference.
checks: Exact source bytes, identifiers and SHA256
Ordinal probability keys, sum, expected score
Fresh candidate prefixes and K fresh calls
Returned order, symbol deduplication and evidence-qualified ranks
All latency stage sums, medians, nearest-rank p95 and quality metrics
Named origin reuse of exact prior responses
Index manifest fingerprint, dimensions, finite unit vectors
p95_note: With 14 search samples per condition, nearest-rank p95 equals the observed maximum.
